name: astra-forge
description: Project AstraForge — Tony Stark-style holographic design space bridging 2D images, AI generation, and physical fabrication

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev -w @astraforge/server" "npm run dev -w @astraforge/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @astraforge/shared && npm run build -w @astraforge/server && npm run build -w @astraforge/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @astraforge/shared && npm run typecheck -w @astraforge/server && npm run typecheck -w @astraforge/web
scripts.lint: echo "no lint configured yet — run typecheck" && npm run typecheck
scripts.vision:setup: python -m venv services/vision/.venv && services/vision/.venv/Scripts/python -m pip install -r services/vision/requirements.txt || python3 -m venv services/vision/.venv && services/vision/.venv/bin/pip install -r services/vision/requirements.txt
